item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 04/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring warm and humid weather to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. The trough of low pressure over the northern part of southern China is expected to develop into a cold front on Thursday, and move across the coast of Guangdong between Thursday night and Friday morning. There will be showers and a few thunderstorms over the region. Temperatures will fall slightly. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, the weather will be windy and brighter over the coastal areas of Guangdong during the weekend. With the northeast monsoon moderating early next week, temperatures will rise over the region.
